directions.name: Atlas
directions.thesis: An AI platform with the confidence of an editorial institution, not a reseller landing page.
directions.ownWorld: Porcelain white #F5F5F1, dark pine ink #20352F, vermilion #B4412C. Newsreader display and DM Sans UI. Strong horizontal rules, deliberate asymmetric whitespace, very few containers.
directions.story: Understand UltrAI; see a real example of thinking with AI; enter a workspace or build through the API.
directions.firstViewport: Compact wordmark navigation above a large left-aligned serif proposition; a tall editorial live-demo sheet at right with three selectable work examples. A full-width two-journey row below. No eyebrow, fake metrics or model logo wall.
directions.interaction: A work-example selector rewrites the editorial demonstration without moving its frame.
directions.crossSurface: Workspace as a calm writing desk; console as a ruled research ledger with readable API setup.
directions.risk: Can feel too editorial for users who expect a dense technical dashboard.
raises: Shader portal: commit to the whole viewport, not a decorative widget.
Akari: every control inherits the same material and spacing grammar.
Night city: hierarchy must survive a low-distraction focused workspace.
Sampler: specimens demonstrate real tasks with deliberate type hierarchy.
Cabaret: one emphatic typographic focal point, no competing hero fragments.

directions.name: Studio
directions.thesis: One precise product workspace connecting everyday AI use to developer creation.
directions.ownWorld: Cool white #F6F8FC, deep navy #13264A, cobalt #245BE8. Manrope display and DM Sans UI. Broad open planes, restrained 12px panels, navy feature stage and luminous but flat blue controls.
directions.story: Choose use or build immediately, inspect the workspace, then explore the developer console.
directions.firstViewport: A large asymmetrical sans heading next to a full-size usable workspace sample, followed by one wide navy API demonstration rather than a repetitive card grid.
directions.interaction: User switches between writing, coding and planning examples in a task-oriented workbench.
directions.crossSurface: Workspace uses a purposeful left rail and central composer; console shows setup and request activity, not invented top-line business metrics.
directions.risk: The most familiar SaaS direction; disciplined typography and content must prevent generic-template drift.

directions.name: Signal
directions.thesis: An AI control room where capabilities, current task and system actions are immediately scannable.
directions.ownWorld: Ink navy #11191E, dark steel #1A252B, warm white #E8EEE9, amber #F6BE56. IBM Plex Sans display/UI, IBM Plex Mono for code and measured data only. Ruled rows, fixed columns, functional status labels.
directions.story: Discover available capabilities through a live capability board; open chat or the console without a proxy metaphor.
directions.firstViewport: Oversized left-aligned heading over a broad semantic capability board; amber action at the heading baseline. Selectable capability rows occupy the rest of the viewport, not small dashboard cards.
directions.interaction: Changing a capability triggers one bounded row-update cascade, reduced-motion safe.
directions.crossSurface: Workspace as a focused operator station; console as a queryable request board and readable API sample.
directions.risk: Strongest developer character; everyday-user friendliness must be retained with plain-language tasks and generous spacing.
directions.case: Wins on developer identification and scanning; does not beat Atlas for broad-audience warmth.

challengers.case: Clear model capability rows resonate with developer work while keeping everyday tasks visible.
Spectacle distracts from the two jobs; does not explain the product better.
Craft object metaphor is remote from AI work and integration.
challengers.kept: Consistent material grammar across all controls.

challengers.case: Urban lighting cannot clarify AI product capabilities without becoming decorative.
challengers.kept: Strict hierarchy under dark, low-distraction conditions.

challengers.case: Textile learning artifact is not part of the audience's primary operating scene.
challengers.kept: Every specimen carries a concrete task rather than decorative sample copy.

challengers.case: Expressionist performance conflicts with quiet daily operation and developer clarity.

implementation.server: Local-only Bun static server; serve this directory, never the repository or environment files
implementation.owner: Main owns gallery, server, shared typefaces, validation and integration
implementation.variants: Each direction owns its own subdirectory; three surfaces: landing, workspace, console
implementation.storage: Preview-only UI state; no backend calls, payment actions, real API keys or live credentials
implementation.content: Indonesian; accurate provider/model makers; all sample content and usage labeled demo
implementation.assets: Local self-hosted font files; inline authored geometric SVG icons; no raster assets needed
implementation.verification: Browser desktop/mobile captures, overflow/error checks, navigation and primary controls exercised; one detector pass after implementation

finish: Deliver three complete interactive prototype directions and comparison links; do not select or implement the production design on the owner's behalf.
